title: The Healer Who Cannot See the Illness

collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A healer asks whether distant physicians might have tools for observing things too small for the naked eye.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After treating a fever, a healer asks whether distant physicians might have tools for observing things too small for the naked eye.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Researchers experiment with water droplets and curved clear materials as crude lenses.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Their improvised device distorts the view; the healer cautions against mistaking an artifact for evidence.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The healers discuss the possibility of tiny living agents and other invisible processes.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A villager fears every unseen thing; the healer explains that a hypothesis is not a reason to panic.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The group concludes that careful listening and observation would still matter.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A patient reminds them that expensive tools would be little comfort if care were unavailable.
